questions.question: A tank has two inlets A and B that can fill it in 5 h and 6 h respectively. An outlet C can empty the full tank in 30 h. If all the three pipes are opened together in the empty tank, how much time will the pipes take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
Given:

A tank has two inlets A and B that can fill it in 5 h and 6 h respectively. 

An outlet C can empty the full tank in 30 h.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (5, 6, 30) = 30

Let the capacity of the tank be the LCM of the time taken by all pipes.

Hence, the capacity of the tank = 30 units

Thus,

Inlet A fills the tank each hour by = 30 ÷ 5 = 6 units

Inlet B fills the tank each hour by = 30 ÷ 6 = 5 units

Outlet C empties the tank each hour by = 30 ÷ 30 = 1 unit

Hence, time taken to fill the tank when all pipes are opened = {30 over (6 + 5 - 1)} = 3 hours

**∴ All the three pipes are opened together in the empty tank, 3 hours will the pipes take to fill the tank.**

questions.question: sqrt2 - sqrt3 is :
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The difference between two **distinct irrational numbers** (√2 and √3) where neither is a multiple of the other by a rational factor always results in an **irrational number**.

√2 ≈ 1.4142... and √3 ≈ 1.7320...

√2 − √3 ≈ −0.3178... which is **non-terminating** and **non-repeating**.

Such decimals represent **irrational numbers**.

**∴ The correct answer is an irrational number.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a66fef762b3a499b37e614dd1f5485f2dbf4ae6963c6d7808ebf924a22ec4b1a.png] 

**Given:** The expression is √2 − √3.

**Method:** Proof by **Contradiction**.

⇒ Let us assume that √2 − √3 = r, where r is a **rational number**.

⇒ Squaring both sides: (√2 − √3)² = r²

⇒ (√2)² + (√3)² − 2(√2 × √3) = r²

⇒ 2 + 3 − 2√6 = r²

⇒ 5 − 2√6 = r²

⇒ 5 − r² = 2√6

⇒ √6 = (5 − r²) / 2

⇒ Since r is rational, r² is rational, and (5 − r²) / 2 is also **rational**.

⇒ However, √6 is an **irrational number** (as 6 is not a perfect square).

⇒ An irrational number cannot be equal to a rational number.

⇒ This is a **contradiction**, so our assumption was wrong.

**∴ The correct answer is an irrational number.**

**__Additional Information__**

Irrational Numbers

These are numbers that cannot be expressed as a ratio of two integers (p/q). Their decimal expansion is **non-terminating** and **non-repeating**.

Properties of Irrationals

The sum or difference of a rational and an irrational number is always **irrational**. The sum or difference of two irrationals may be rational or irrational.

Square Roots of Primes

The **square root** of any **prime number** (like 2, 3, 5, 7, etc.) is always an irrational number.

Real Numbers

Real numbers are the union of **rational numbers** and **irrational numbers**. Every point on the number line represents a unique real number.</p

questions.question: Name the drainage pattern where the river originates from a hill and flows in all directions.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Radial.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​When the rivers originate from a hill and flow in all directions, the drainage pattern is known as **‘radial’. **
 
• Volcanoes usually display excellent radial drainage.
 
• The rivers originating from the Amarkantak range present a good example of it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Centripetal Patterns

 
 
• ​When the rivers discharge their waters from all directions in a lake or depression, the pattern is known as ‘centripetal’.** **
 
 
 
• ​Dendritic patterns
 
 
• These are by far the most common, develop in areas where the rock (or unconsolidated material) beneath the stream has no particular fabric or structure and can be eroded equally easily in all directions.
 
• The drainage pattern resembling the branches of a tree is known as “dendritic” the examples of which are the rivers of the northern plain. ** **
 
 
 
• Trellis drainage
 
 
• When the primary tributaries of rivers flow parallel to each other and secondary tributaries join them at right angles, the pattern is known as ‘trellis’. ** **

average age of the family consisting of the husband, wife and their son is 34 years.

questions.question: In the expansion of (x + 3)³, the coefficient of x is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In the **binomial expansion** of (x + a)ⁿ, the term containing x¹ is given by ⁿCₙ−₁ × x¹ × aⁿ−¹.

Here, n = 3 and a = 3.

Coefficient of x = ³C₂ × 3³−¹ = 3 × 3²

Coefficient = 3 × 9 = 27.

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The algebraic expression (x + 3)³.

**Formula Used:** (a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df44b5d81a77e6720f236d9fbb67b506a5fa75d1e84ae37b11518466763d4d12.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let a = x and b = 3.

⇒ (x + 3)³ = x³ + 3(x²)(3) + 3(x)(3²) + 3³

⇒ (x + 3)³ = x³ + 9x² + 3(x)(9) + 27

⇒ (x + 3)³ = x³ + 9x² + 27x + 27

⇒ The **coefficient** is the numerical factor of the variable term.

⇒ In the term 27x, the coefficient of x is 27.

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Binomial Theorem

The general expansion of (x + y)ⁿ is Σ ⁿCₖ × xⁿ−k × yk for k = 0 to n.

Algebraic Identity (a − b)³

The expansion of (a − b)³ is a³ − 3a²b + 3ab² − b³.

Coefficient Definition

A **coefficient** is a multiplicative factor in some term of a polynomial, a series, or any expression; it is usually a number.</p

Study the given statement and the conclusions carefully and decide which of the following conclusions follow(s) the given statement logically.

**Statement:**

The British introduced the postal system in India in 1764.

**Conclusions:**

I. Postal letters often are late, or they are lost.

II. Postmen get less salary, so they tend to do mistakes.

options.text: Neither of the conclusions I or II follow
Both of the conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
According to the given information,

**Conclusions 1 **→ This is not implicit, because there is no relationship between when the postal system was established and Postal letters often being late, or they are lost.

**Conclusions​ 2 **→ This is not implicit, because there is no statement given regarding postman salary and why they do mistakes.

Hence,** “Neither of the conclusions I or II follow".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• If there are two or more sentences that are used to frame a statement, then, the sentences must be interrelated, and mutual contradiction should be there.
 
• Do not look for truthful notions. The information provided in the statement is the only requirement for a student to answer the question. No assumptions must be made.
 
• Read the statement carefully and look for keywords that are common between the statement and the conclusions
